Cabin readiness, a friendly note before departure
We write to travelers

Companion animal travel notice

If you are bringing a companion animal on Aurelia Skyways, please review the cabin and document checks before you leave for the airport. This notice helps you travel with less stress and gives our team a clear path to assist you.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk looks over each booking with care and keeps the process calm for travelers and pets alike. The safety coordinator checks for common risks and helps prevent delays, while the ground team handles carriers gently between services. If your trip includes a reptile, <<FACT F060>>. If you are traveling with a bird, <<FACT F065>>.

Please keep the pet healthy, comfortable, and ready for screening before arrival. If you are traveling with a small dog, <<FACT F080>>. Bring the papers you were asked for, use a secure carrier, and make sure the carrier is easy for staff to see and move. Pepper and other pets should have enough space to settle without crowding.

If anything is unclear, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure.
